VTS Scoring Log

Felix Chemical Supply

felixchem.is · Est. 2022 · United States (Chem-LLC) · Scored August 2026

Felix Chemical Supply's entire site requires account registration to access - products, COAs, and policy pages all redirect to a login prompt. Evidence in public educational guides and community resources confirms testing via Chromate, a US-based lab, with HPLC, mass spectrometry, and endotoxin panels included from November 2025 onward. Chromate COAs include a COA number and Access Code at the bottom that allows independent verification through Chromate's own platform - but a researcher must be a customer with a COA in hand before that verification path becomes available. Pre-purchase documentation review is not possible without creating an account. The operating entity is identified as Chem-LLC in registration records. The Low band score reflects the login-gate architecture, not the underlying testing quality.

34 /100
Low
Entire site login-gated. Chromate named lab with HPLC + MS + endotoxin testing confirmed via public sources, but zero documentation accessible to unauthenticated visitors. Chem-LLC entity identifiable. Score reflects accessibility architecture, not testing quality.

Community Signal
Independent Test Results
A public COA example for AOD-9604 (batch 022825-AOD5) shows 99.431% purity via Chromate, with an independently verifiable COA number. This is a single documented example from a public educational resource, not a community-submitted test. Chromate COA number and Access Code allow independent verification through Chromate's platform.
Community Experience
Peptide Critic documents a 4.5/5 community rating from a small number of reviews. Community feedback from sources that have accessed the site notes endotoxin testing as a meaningful differentiator and describes fast fulfillment. The small review volume limits characterization of patterns.
Scoring Notes
Endotoxin testing is a genuine differentiator
Most vendors in this catalog do not include endotoxin testing in their standard panel. Felix Chemical Supply added endotoxin as a standard offering from November 2025. If this documentation were publicly accessible, the testing scope dimension score would be materially higher. The Login-gate is what limits the overall score, not the underlying testing quality.
The Chromate verification path is post-purchase only
Chromate COAs include a COA number and Access Code at the bottom of each document, allowing researchers to independently verify the result through Chromate's own platform. This is a meaningful verification mechanism - but it requires being a customer first. A researcher evaluating this vendor before purchase has no access to any COA, and therefore no way to use the Chromate verification path before making a buying decision.
Sources: felixchem.is (login page at time of scoring), Chromate COA example reproduced at peptides4newbies.com/coas/ (client: Felixchem.co, batch: 022825-AOD5, COA #23300), Chem-LLC registration records, community documentation. VTS measures process transparency from publicly available materials only. It is not a certification of product safety, purity, or efficacy. PeptideClear has no affiliate, referral, or commercial relationship with Felix Chemical Supply. Scored August 2026 - reviewed on a rolling basis as vendor practices change.
